## 1  Setup and Configuration

### 1.1  Load shared utilities and user configuration

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo    = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  fig.width  = 11,
  fig.height = 8,
  dpi        = 150      # lower for Rmd preview; save_wq_map() uses 300 dpi
)
```

```{r load_config_and_functions}
# Source user path configuration (copy config_template.R → config.R first)
config_path <- "config.R"
if (!file.exists(config_path)) {
  stop(
    "config.R not found in the working directory.\n",
    "Copy config_template.R to config.R and fill in your local data paths.\n",
    "Working directory: ", getwd()
  )
}
source(config_path)

# Source shared utility functions (installs missing packages automatically)
source("00_shared_functions.R")
```

### 1.2  Build parameter settings

All eight WQ parameter configurations (units, colour range, palette, I/O paths)
are assembled from `config.R` values.

```{r parameter_settings}
param_settings <- build_parameter_settings()

# Display the configured parameters
cat("Parameters configured:", paste(names(param_settings), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Data root:   ", DATA_ROOT,   "\n")
cat("Output root: ", OUTPUT_ROOT, "\n")
```

## 2  Map Creation Function

`create_all_network_map()` generates one publication-quality spatial map for
a single GeoTIFF input. It handles:

- Dynamic spatial buffering (wider for Khlong Nueng, narrower for wider channels)
- CartoDB basemap tiles with three-provider automatic fallback
- Consistent scale bar (`ggspatial::annotation_scale`) and north arrow
- Clamped colour ramp with labelled Low/High endpoints
- Bold title and subtitle via `ggtext`

```{r map_creation_function}
#' Create a publication-quality WQ spatial map for the full canal network.
#'
#' @param raster_data  Named list with elements \code{raster} (SpatRaster),
#'   \code{info} (output of \code{parse_allnetwork_filename()}), and
#'   \code{file_path} (character).
#' @param parameter_name Character. WQ parameter label (used in legend/title).
#' @param unit      Character. Unit string for the colour-bar label.
#' @param min_val   Numeric. Lower clamp value for the colour ramp.
#' @param max_val   Numeric. Upper clamp value for the colour ramp.
#' @param color_palette Character vector. Colour stops for the gradient.
#' @param reverse_colors Logical. Reverse the palette (e.g. for DO). Default FALSE.
#' @param verbose   Logical. Print diagnostics. Default FALSE.
#' @return A ggplot object, or NULL on failure.
create_all_network_map <- function(raster_data,
                                   parameter_name,
                                   unit,
                                   min_val,
                                   max_val,
                                   color_palette  = c("blue","cyan","green",
                                                      "yellow","orange","red",
                                                      "magenta"),
                                   reverse_colors = FALSE,
                                   verbose        = FALSE) {

  # ── Input validation ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (is.null(raster_data) ||
      !inherits(raster_data$raster, "SpatRaster")) {
    message(parameter_name, ": invalid raster_data supplied — skipping.")
    return(NULL)
  }

  raster_df <- as.data.frame(raster_data$raster, xy = TRUE) |> stats::na.omit()
  if (nrow(raster_df) == 0L) {
    message(parameter_name, ": raster is entirely NA — skipping.")
    return(NULL)
  }
  names(raster_df)[3L] <- parameter_name

  # ── Spatial geometry ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  shape_info <- analyze_raster_shape(raster_data$raster)
  if (is.na(shape_info$width) || shape_info$width <= 0) {
    message(parameter_name, ": invalid raster dimensions — skipping.")
    return(NULL)
  }

  if (verbose) {
    cat(sprintf("%s: %d data points; aspect ratio %.2f\n",
                parameter_name, nrow(raster_df), shape_info$aspect_ratio))
  }

  r_ext   <- terra::ext(raster_data$raster)
  x_range <- c(as.numeric(r_ext[1L]), as.numeric(r_ext[2L]))
  y_range <- c(as.numeric(r_ext[3L]), as.numeric(r_ext[4L]))

  if (!all(is.finite(c(x_range, y_range)))) {
    message(parameter_name, ": non-finite coordinate range — skipping.")
    return(NULL)
  }

  dw <- x_range[2L] - x_range[1L]
  dh <- y_range[2L] - y_range[1L]

  buf <- shape_info$buffer_percent
  if (!is.finite(buf)) buf <- 0.1

  # Water-body-specific buffer multipliers
  wb <- raster_data$info$water_body
  if (grepl("Khlong_Nueng", wb, fixed = TRUE)) {
    xm <- 3.0; ym <- 1.2
  } else if (grepl("Chao_Phraya", wb, fixed = TRUE)) {
    xm <- 0.8; ym <- 0.3
  } else if (isTRUE(shape_info$is_vertical)) {
    xm <- 2.0; ym <- 0.6
  } else if (isTRUE(shape_info$is_horizontal)) {
    xm <- 1.3; ym <- 0.8
  } else {
    xm <- 1.2; ym <- 0.6
  }

  xmin_buf <- as.numeric(x_range[1L] - buf * xm * dw)
  xmax_buf <- as.numeric(x_range[2L] + buf * xm * dw)
  ymin_buf <- as.numeric(y_range[1L] - buf * ym * dh)
  ymax_buf <- as.numeric(y_range[2L] + buf * ym * dh)

  if (xmin_buf >= xmax_buf || ymin_buf >= ymax_buf) {
    message(parameter_name, ": bounding box collapsed after buffering — skipping.")
    return(NULL)
  }

  # ── CRS and bounding box ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  crs_str  <- tryCatch(terra::crs(raster_data$raster), error = function(e) "")
  safe_crs <- tryCatch(
    sf::st_crs(if (nchar(crs_str) > 0L) crs_str else "EPSG:4326"),
    error = function(e) sf::st_crs(4326L)
  )

  bbox     <- sf::st_bbox(c(xmin = xmin_buf, ymin = ymin_buf,
                             xmax = xmax_buf, ymax = ymax_buf),
                           crs = safe_crs)
  bbox_sfc <- tryCatch(sf::st_as_sfc(bbox), error = function(e) NULL)

  # ── Basemap tiles ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  tiles      <- fetch_basemap_tiles(bbox_sfc)
  tile_alpha <- if (!is.null(tiles)) 0.80 else 0
  if (grepl("Khlong_Nueng", wb, fixed = TRUE)) tile_alpha <- 0.95

  # ── Colour ramp ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  ramp <- colorRampPalette(color_palette)(100L)
  if (reverse_colors) ramp <- rev(ramp)

  # ── ggplot assembly ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Scale-bar width_hint = 0.25 pushes the reference distance above 1600 m
  # so ggspatial selects "km" consistently across all Chao Phraya parameters.
  # Verified: 0.22 → 1422 m ("1000 m"), 0.25 → 1616 m ("1 km").
  width_hint_sb <- if (grepl("Khlong_Nueng", wb, fixed = TRUE)) 0.20 else 0.25
  arrow_cm      <- if (grepl("Khlong_Nueng", wb, fixed = TRUE)) {
    max(0.7, min(1.5, sqrt((xmax_buf - xmin_buf)^2 +
                            (ymax_buf - ymin_buf)^2) * 5e-5))
  } else 1.5

  title_text <- gsub("_", " ", wb)
  subtitle_text <- if (parameter_name == "pH") {
    paste0("pH \u2014 ", raster_data$info$date_string)
  } else {
    unit_str <- trimws(unit)
    if (nchar(unit_str) > 0L) {
      paste0(parameter_name, " (", unit_str, ") \u2014 ",
             raster_data$info$date_string)
    } else {
      paste0(parameter_name, " \u2014 ", raster_data$info$date_string)
    }
  }

  map <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
    { if (!is.null(tiles))
        tidyterra::geom_spatraster_rgb(data = tiles, alpha = tile_alpha)
      else
        ggplot2::theme(
          panel.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "grey92")
        )
    } +
    ggplot2::geom_tile(
      data = raster_df,
      ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = y, fill = !!rlang::sym(parameter_name)),
      alpha = 0.8
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_gradientn(
      colors  = ramp,
      limits  = c(min_val, max_val),
      oob     = scales::squish,
      name    = NULL,
      breaks  = c(min_val, max_val),
      labels  = c(paste("Low:", min_val), paste("High:", max_val)),
      guide   = ggplot2::guide_colorbar(
        direction      = "vertical",
        barheight      = ggplot2::unit(1.5, "cm"),
        barwidth       = ggplot2::unit(0.3, "cm"),
        label.position = "left",
        label.hjust    = 1,
        ticks          = TRUE,
        nbin           = 10L
      )
    ) +
    ggspatial::annotation_north_arrow(
      location    = "tr",
      which_north = "grid",
      pad_x = ggplot2::unit(0.5, "cm"),
      pad_y = ggplot2::unit(0.5, "cm"),
      style = ggspatial::north_arrow_fancy_orienteering(
        fill    = c("white","black"),
        line_col = "black",
        text_col = "black"
      ),
      height = ggplot2::unit(arrow_cm, "cm"),
      width  = ggplot2::unit(arrow_cm, "cm")
    ) +
    ggspatial::annotation_scale(
      location   = "br",
      width_hint = width_hint_sb,
      style      = "bar",
      text_cex   = 1.0,
      line_width = 1.2,
      pad_x      = ggplot2::unit(0.4, "cm"),
      pad_y      = ggplot2::unit(0.15, "cm"),
      bar_cols   = c("black","white"),
      unit_category = "metric"
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title    = paste0("**", title_text, "**"),
      subtitle = subtitle_text
    ) +
    ggplot2::coord_sf(
      xlim   = c(xmin_buf, xmax_buf),
      ylim   = c(ymin_buf, ymax_buf),
      expand = FALSE,
      crs    = safe_crs
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      panel.grid        = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.title        = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.text         = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.ticks        = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      plot.title        = ggtext::element_markdown(
                            size = 17, hjust = 0.5, margin = ggplot2::margin(b = 6)
                          ),
      plot.subtitle     = ggplot2::element_text(size = 15, hjust = 0.5),
      legend.title      = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      legend.text       = ggplot2::element_text(size = 13),
      legend.position   = c(-0.001, 0.525),
      legend.justification = c(0, 0.5),
      legend.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = NA, color = NA),
      legend.key.height = ggplot2::unit(1.5, "cm"),
      legend.key.width  = ggplot2::unit(0.3, "cm"),
      legend.margin     = ggplot2::margin(1, 1, 1, 1),
      plot.margin       = ggplot2::margin(10, 10, 10, 10),
      panel.background  = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = NA),
      panel.border      = ggplot2::element_rect(
                            color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5
                          )
    )

  map
}
```

## 3  Workflow Functions

### 3.1  Preview a single file

```{r single_file_preview_function}
#' Load and render one GeoTIFF as a WQ map (for interactive inspection).
#'
#' @param parameter_name Character. One of the names in \code{param_settings}.
#' @param file_index     Integer. Position in the sorted file list. Default 1.
#' @param verbose        Logical. Print file list and diagnostics. Default TRUE.
#' @return A ggplot object, or NULL.
preview_wq_parameter <- function(parameter_name, file_index = 1L,
                                  verbose = TRUE) {
  s <- param_settings[[parameter_name]]
  if (is.null(s)) {
    message("preview_wq_parameter: '", parameter_name, "' not found in settings.")
    return(NULL)
  }

  files <- list_available_files(parameter_name, s, verbose = verbose)
  if (length(files) == 0L) return(NULL)

  fi <- max(1L, min(file_index, length(files)))
  if (fi != file_index)
    message("File index adjusted to ", fi, " (valid range 1–", length(files), ").")

  rinfo <- parse_allnetwork_filename(files[fi])
  if (is.null(rinfo)) return(NULL)

  r <- tryCatch(terra::rast(files[fi]), error = function(e) {
    message("Error loading raster: ", e$message); NULL
  })
  if (is.null(r)) return(NULL)

  rdata <- list(raster = r, info = rinfo, file_path = files[fi])

  map <- create_all_network_map(
    raster_data    = rdata,
    parameter_name = parameter_name,
    unit           = s$unit,
    min_val        = s$min_val,
    max_val        = s$max_val,
    color_palette  = s$color_palette,
    reverse_colors = s$reverse_colors,
    verbose        = verbose
  )
  map
}
```

### 3.2  Batch-render all files for a parameter

```{r batch_render_function}
#' Render and optionally save maps for all GeoTIFFs of one parameter.
#'
#' @param parameter_name Character. Parameter to process.
#' @param save_maps      Logical. Save PNG/PDF files to disk. Default FALSE.
#' @param verbose        Logical. Print per-file progress. Default TRUE.
#' @return Named list of ggplot objects (invisibly).
batch_render_parameter <- function(parameter_name, save_maps = FALSE,
                                    verbose = TRUE) {
  s <- param_settings[[parameter_name]]
  if (is.null(s)) {
    message("batch_render_parameter: '", parameter_name, "' not in settings.")
    return(invisible(list()))
  }

  files <- list_available_files(parameter_name, s, verbose = verbose)
  if (length(files) == 0L) return(invisible(list()))

  message("\nProcessing ", length(files), " file(s) for [", parameter_name, "]...")

  map_list <- list()

  for (fp in files) {
    rinfo <- parse_allnetwork_filename(fp)
    if (is.null(rinfo)) next

    r <- tryCatch(terra::rast(fp), error = function(e) {
      message("Error loading: ", basename(fp), " — ", e$message); NULL
    })
    if (is.null(r)) next

    rdata <- list(raster = r, info = rinfo, file_path = fp)

    map <- create_all_network_map(
      raster_data    = rdata,
      parameter_name = parameter_name,
      unit           = s$unit,
      min_val        = s$min_val,
      max_val        = s$max_val,
      color_palette  = s$color_palette,
      reverse_colors = s$reverse_colors,
      verbose        = verbose
    )

    if (!is.null(map)) {
      key <- paste(rinfo$water_body, rinfo$month_name, rinfo$year, sep = "_")
      map_list[[key]] <- map
      print(map)

      if (save_maps) {
        save_wq_map(
          map          = map,
          output_dir   = s$output_dir,
          water_body   = rinfo$water_body,
          parameter    = parameter_name,
          month_abbr   = rinfo$month_abbr,
          year         = rinfo$year
        )
      }
    }
  }

  message("Finished [", parameter_name, "]: ", length(map_list),
          " map(s) rendered.\n")
  invisible(map_list)
}
```

## 4  Usage Examples

Edit the calls below to explore or batch-process any parameter.

### 4.1  Preview a single map (interactive use)

```{r example_single_preview}
# List available files for Turbidity
list_available_files("Turbidity", param_settings[["Turbidity"]])

# Other single-file previews:
```

